g.text: 13. HTTP 200: streamed MCP result to caller
Only tier 1 (transport) changes the HTTP status; tiers 2-3 stay HTTP 200.
A client must check both the JSON-RPC error object and CallToolResult.isError.
Full three-tier explanation in the embedding doc (ADR-006).
